name: window_funnel
description:
Searches for an ordered chain of events, where an event is a row that satisfies one of the conditions,
and returns the number of conditions reached in order, starting with the first one.
Every event of the chain must happen at most `maxspan` after the event that satisfied the first
condition. Events don't need to be consecutive, rows that satisfy no condition are ignored,
and a single row can satisfy several consecutive conditions.
Returns `0` when no row satisfies the first condition.

params.name: maxspan
params.description: The maximum time between the event that satisfies the first condition and the last event of the chain.

params.name: conditions
params.description: Between one and 32 conditions, in the order the events must happen.

params.name: conditions
params.description: Between one and 32 conditions, in the order the events must happen.

examples:
FROM funnel_events
| STATS level = WINDOW_FUNNEL(1 hour, @timestamp, action == "view", action == "cart", action == "checkout", action == "purchase") BY user
| SORT user

FROM funnel_events
| STATS level = WINDOW_FUNNEL(15 minutes, @timestamp, action == "view", action == "cart", action == "checkout") BY user, session
| SORT user, session
